# archestra_openappa_battery_install (Resource)

Includes an OpenAPPA guardrails battery in the organization's policy and, for a battery that governs MCP servers, attaches it to one registry entry. A battery made of annotators alone governs the whole organization and is installed without `catalog_id`. Writes edit the organization's policy text, so they fail while a GitHub repository owns that text. Credential bindings are managed separately and are read-only here. Import an existing install by UUID. Requires API 1.5.0-rc.1 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires Archestra 1.5.0-rc.1 or later with OpenAPPA guardrails enabled.
# Installs edit the organization's policy text, so they fail while a GitHub
# repository owns that text.
resource "archestra_mcp_registry_entry" "github" {
  name = "github"
  remote_config = {
    url = "https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/"
  }
}

# A battery that governs MCP servers attaches to one registry entry. The
# entry needs synced tools first: install the server before the battery.
resource "archestra_openappa_battery_install" "github" {
  battery_name = "github"
  catalog_id   = archestra_mcp_registry_entry.github.id
}

# Detach a battery from an entry but keep it included with enabled = false.
# A battery made of annotators alone governs the whole organization: install
# it without catalog_id. Pin an uploaded battery package with package_hash.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `battery_name` (String) Name of a bundled or uploaded battery, as `GET /api/openappa/batteries` lists it.

### Optional

- `catalog_id` (String) Registry entry (`archestra_mcp_registry_entry`) the battery governs. Omit for a battery that governs the organization.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the battery is attached to `catalog_id` (default `true`). `false` detaches it but keeps the battery included; only installs with a `catalog_id` can be disabled.
- `package_hash` (String) SHA-256 of an uploaded battery package to run; omit for the bundled battery of that name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `credential_bindings` (Map of String) Helper variables bound to organization credentials, keyed by variable name.
- `id` (String) Battery install UUID.
- `last_error` (String) Most recent error applying the battery, if any.
- `status` (String) Install state, such as `active`, `missing_credentials`, `naming_conflict` or `unavailable`.
- `target` (String) Target the battery deploys as (`multi-user`), or null for its base alone.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing install by the UUID GET /api/openappa/batteries lists as installs[].id.
terraform import archestra_openappa_battery_install.github 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
